#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end smoke test against a running application.

Usage: ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD=... python3 scripts/e2e_smoke.py [base_url]

Walks the full lifecycle: network setup, users, serviceability dry run,
collection request, assignment offers, collection + sealing, custody handoffs,
laboratory receipt, replanning and audit search.
"""
import os
import sys
import uuid
import datetime as dt

import requests

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
API = BASE + "/api"
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")


def now(offset_minutes=0):
    return (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) + dt.timedelta(minutes=offset_minutes)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


class Client:
    def __init__(self, token=None):
        self.token = token

    def call(self, path, body=None, method="POST", expect=None):
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}"} if self.token else {}
        if method == "POST":
            r = requests.post(f"{API}/{path}", json=body if body is not None else {}, headers=headers)
        else:
            r = requests.get(f"{API}/{path}", headers=headers)
        if expect is not None and r.status_code != expect:
            raise AssertionError(f"{method} {path} -> {r.status_code} {r.text} (expected {expect})")
        return r

    def data(self, path, body=None, expect=None, method="POST"):
        r = self.call(path, body, method=method, expect=expect)
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            raise AssertionError(f"{path}: {r.status_code} {r.text}")
        return r.json()["data"]


def login(username, password, role=None):
    r = requests.post(f"{API}/authenticate-user", json={"username": username, "password": password})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    d = r.json()["data"]
    c = Client(d["sessionToken"])
    if role:
        c.data("select-active-role", {"role": role}, expect=200)
    return c, d


def main():
    print("== login admin")
    admin, info = login(ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
    assert "administrator" in info["roles"]
    if info["activeRole"] != "administrator":
        admin.data("select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"})
    assert requests.get(BASE + "/ready").json() == {"status": "ready"}
    # invalid credentials
    r = requests.post(f"{API}/authenticate-user", json={"username": ADMIN_USER, "password": "nope"})
    assert r.status_code == 401 and r.json()["code"] == "invalid_credentials"

    tag = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    print("== network")
    cp = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Collection Centre {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.5200, "longitude": 13.4050}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": 5, "active": True, "functions": ["collection_point", "transfer_point"]}, expect=201)
    hub = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Hub {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.5300, "longitude": 13.4200}, "coverageKm": 3, "handlingMinutes": 10, "active": True, "functions": ["hub"]}, expect=201)
    lab = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Laboratory {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.5400, "longitude": 13.4400}, "coverageKm": 2, "handlingMinutes": 5, "active": True, "functions": ["laboratory"]}, expect=201)
    for loc in (cp, hub, lab):
        admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": loc["locationId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    c1 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": cp["locationId"], "toLocationId": hub["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 20, "costUnits": 3, "cooled": True, "active": True}, expect=201)
    c2 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": hub["locationId"], "toLocationId": lab["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 25, "costUnits": 4, "cooled": True, "active": True}, expect=201)
    for c in (c1, c2):
        admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": c["connectionId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    catalog = admin.data("ui/catalog", method="GET")
    types = {t["name"]: t for t in catalog["sampleTypes"]}
    assert {"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"} <= set(types), types.keys()
    amber = types["Amber"]
    for t in types.values():
        admin.data("configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab["locationId"], "sampleTypeId": t["sampleTypeId"], "accepts": True}, expect=200)
    snap = admin.data("read-serviceability-snapshot", {})
    assert snap["status"] == "complete" and snap["activeCollectionPointCount"] >= 1

    print("== users")
    pw = "Passw0rd!"
    def mk(username, roles, **extra):
        body = {"username": username, "initialPassword": pw, "fullName": username, "roles": roles, "active": True}
        body.update(extra)
        return admin.data("create-user", body, expect=201)
    requester = mk(f"req_{tag}", ["requester"])
    collector = mk(f"col_{tag}", ["collection_professional"], qualifications=["amber"], certifications=[{"code": "amber", "active": True}])
    courier1 = mk(f"cour1_{tag}", ["delivery_partner"])
    courier2 = mk(f"cour2_{tag}", ["delivery_partner"])
    hubworker = mk(f"hub_{tag}", ["node_handler"], assignedLocationId=hub["locationId"])
    cpworker = mk(f"cp_{tag}", ["node_handler"], assignedLocationId=cp["locationId"])
    labworker = mk(f"lab_{tag}", ["laboratory_team", "requester"], assignedLocationId=lab["locationId"])
    r = admin.call("create-user", {"username": f"req_{tag}", "initialPassword": pw, "roles": ["requester"], "active": True})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "username_exists"

    print("== multi-role selection")
    labc, labinfo = login(labworker["username"], pw)
    assert labinfo["activeRole"] == "" and set(labinfo["roles"]) == {"laboratory_team", "requester"}
    r = labc.call("list-role-work", {})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "role_not_selected", r.text
    r = labc.call("select-active-role", {"role": "dispatcher"})
    assert r.status_code == 403 and r.json()["code"] == "role_not_held"
    sel = labc.data("select-active-role", {"role": "laboratory_team"}, expect=200)
    assert sel["activeRole"] == "laboratory_team" and set(sel["roles"]) == {"laboratory_team", "requester"}
    boot = labc.data("ui/bootstrap", method="GET")
    assert boot["user"]["activeRole"] == "laboratory_team" and boot["user"]["roleSelectionRequired"] is False

    print("== serviceability dry run")
    req, _ = login(requester["username"], pw, "requester")
    origin = {"latitude": 52.5215, "longitude": 13.4080}
    body = {"origin": origin, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": amber["sampleTypeId"], "requestedAt": now(), "deliveryDeadline": now(240)}
    sv = req.data("check-serviceability", body, expect=200)
    assert sv["serviceable"] is True and sv["reason"] == "serviceable" and sv["targetLaboratoryId"] == lab["locationId"], sv
    far = req.data("check-serviceability", dict(body, origin={"latitude": 53.9, "longitude": 10.0}), expect=200)
    assert far["serviceable"] is False and far["reason"] == "outside_service_coverage"
    late = req.data("check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=now(10)), expect=200)
    assert late["serviceable"] is False and late["reason"] == "deadline_unreachable", late
    r = req.call("check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=now(-10)))
    assert r.status_code == 400 and r.json()["code"] == "invalid_deadline"
    work = req.data("list-role-work", {})
    assert work["pending"] == [] and work["inProgress"] == [] and work["completed"] == []
    r = req.call("read-operations-state", {})
    assert r.status_code == 403

    print("== collection request")
    cr = req.data("create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType=amber["containerType"], temperatureMinC=amber["temperatureMinC"], temperatureMaxC=amber["temperatureMaxC"], earliestCollectionAt=now(-5), latestCollectionAt=now(90)), expect=201)
    assert cr["serviceability"] == "serviceable" and cr["journeyId"] and cr["activeAssignmentIds"], cr
    sample_id, journey_id = cr["sampleId"], cr["journeyId"]
    r = req.call("create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType="wrong", temperatureMinC=0, temperatureMaxC=1))
    assert r.status_code == 400 and r.json()["code"] == "handling_mismatch"
    state = req.data(f"read-sample-state/{sample_id}", method="GET")
    assert state["state"]["status"] == "pending_collection" and state["timeline"], state
    plan = req.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})
    assert plan["journeyId"] == journey_id and "workerId" not in (plan["legs"][0] if plan["legs"] else {})
    dplan = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})
    assert dplan["routeMode"] == "multi_stop" and len(dplan["legs"]) == 2 and dplan["planVersion"] == 1, dplan
    assert [s["stopType"] for s in dplan["orderedStops"]] == ["pickup", "handoff", "handoff", "delivery"], dplan["orderedStops"]

    print("== collection")
    col, _ = login(collector["username"], pw, "collection_professional")
    work = col.data("list-role-work", {})
    assert len(work["pending"]) == 1 and work["pending"][0]["kind"] == "collection", work

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end smoke test against a running application.

Usage: ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD=... python3 scripts/e2e_smoke.py [base_url]

Walks the full lifecycle: network setup, users, serviceability dry run,
collection request, assignment offers, collection + sealing, custody handoffs,
laboratory receipt, replanning and audit search.
"""
import os
import sys
import uuid
import datetime as dt

import requests

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
API = BASE + "/api"
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")


def now(offset_minutes=0):
    return (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) + dt.timedelta(minutes=offset_minutes)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


class Client:
    def __init__(self, token=None):
        self.token = token

    def call(self, path, body=None, method="POST", expect=None):
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}"} if self.token else {}
        if method == "POST":
            r = requests.post(f"{API}/{path}", json=body if body is not None else {}, headers=headers)
        else:
            r = requests.get(f"{API}/{path}", headers=headers)
        if expect is not None and r.status_code != expect:
            raise AssertionError(f"{method} {path} -> {r.status_code} {r.text} (expected {expect})")
        return r

    def data(self, path, body=None, expect=None, method="POST"):
        r = self.call(path, body, method=method, expect=expect)
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            raise AssertionError(f"{path}: {r.status_code} {r.text}")
        return r.json()["data"]


def login(username, password, role=None):
    r = requests.post(f"{API}/authenticate-user", json={"username": username, "password": password})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    d = r.json()["data"]
    c = Client(d["sessionToken"])
    if role:
        c.data("select-active-role", {"role": role}, expect=200)
    return c, d


def main():
    print("== login admin")
    admin, info = login(ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
    assert "administrator" in info["roles"]
    if info["activeRole"] != "administrator":
        admin.data("select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"})
    assert requests.get(BASE + "/ready").json() == {"status": "ready"}
    # invalid credentials
    r = requests.post(f"{API}/authenticate-user", json={"username": ADMIN_USER, "password": "nope"})
    assert r.status_code == 401 and r.json()["code"] == "invalid_credentials"

    tag = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    print("== network")
    cp = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Collection Centre {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.5200, "longitude": 13.4050}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": 5, "active": True, "functions": ["collection_point", "transfer_point"]}, expect=201)
    hub = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Hub {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.5300, "longitude": 13.4200}, "coverageKm": 3, "handlingMinutes": 10, "active": True, "functions": ["hub"]}, expect=201)
    lab = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Laboratory {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": 52.5400, "longitude": 13.4400}, "coverageKm": 2, "handlingMinutes": 5, "active": True, "functions": ["laboratory"]}, expect=201)
    for loc in (cp, hub, lab):
        admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": loc["locationId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    c1 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": cp["locationId"], "toLocationId": hub["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 20, "costUnits": 3, "cooled": True, "active": True}, expect=201)
    c2 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": hub["locationId"], "toLocationId": lab["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 25, "costUnits": 4, "cooled": True, "active": True}, expect=201)
    for c in (c1, c2):
        admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": c["connectionId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    catalog = admin.data("ui/catalog", method="GET")
    types = {t["name"]: t for t in catalog["sampleTypes"]}
    assert {"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"} <= set(types), types.keys()
    amber = types["Amber"]
    for t in types.values():
        admin.data("configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab["locationId"], "sampleTypeId": t["sampleTypeId"], "accepts": True}, expect=200)
    snap = admin.data("read-serviceability-snapshot", {})
    assert snap["status"] == "complete" and snap["activeCollectionPointCount"] >= 1

    print("== users")
    pw = "Passw0rd!"
    def mk(username, roles, **extra):
        body = {"username": username, "initialPassword": pw, "fullName": username, "roles": roles, "active": True}
        body.update(extra)
        return admin.data("create-user", body, expect=201)
    requester = mk(f"req_{tag}", ["requester"])
    collector = mk(f"col_{tag}", ["collection_professional"], qualifications=["amber"], certifications=[{"code": "amber", "active": True}])
    courier1 = mk(f"cour1_{tag}", ["delivery_partner"])
    courier2 = mk(f"cour2_{tag}", ["delivery_partner"])
    hubworker = mk(f"hub_{tag}", ["node_handler"], assignedLocationId=hub["locationId"])
    cpworker = mk(f"cp_{tag}", ["node_handler"], assignedLocationId=cp["locationId"])
    labworker = mk(f"lab_{tag}", ["laboratory_team", "requester"], assignedLocationId=lab["locationId"])
    r = admin.call("create-user", {"username": f"req_{tag}", "initialPassword": pw, "roles": ["requester"], "active": True})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "username_exists"

    print("== multi-role selection")
    labc, labinfo = login(labworker["username"], pw)
    assert labinfo["activeRole"] == "" and set(labinfo["roles"]) == {"laboratory_team", "requester"}
    r = labc.call("list-role-work", {})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "role_not_selected", r.text
    r = labc.call("select-active-role", {"role": "dispatcher"})
    assert r.status_code == 403 and r.json()["code"] == "role_not_held"
    sel = labc.data("select-active-role", {"role": "laboratory_team"}, expect=200)
    assert sel["activeRole"] == "laboratory_team" and set(sel["roles"]) == {"laboratory_team", "requester"}
    boot = labc.data("ui/bootstrap", method="GET")
    assert boot["user"]["activeRole"] == "laboratory_team" and boot["user"]["roleSelectionRequired"] is False

    print("== serviceability dry run")
    req, _ = login(requester["username"], pw, "requester")
    origin = {"latitude": 52.5215, "longitude": 13.4080}
    body = {"origin": origin, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": amber["sampleTypeId"], "requestedAt": now(), "deliveryDeadline": now(240)}
    sv = req.data("check-serviceability", body, expect=200)
    assert sv["serviceable"] is True and sv["reason"] == "serviceable" and sv["targetLaboratoryId"] == lab["locationId"], sv
    far = req.data("check-serviceability", dict(body, origin={"latitude": 53.9, "longitude": 10.0}), expect=200)
    assert far["serviceable"] is False and far["reason"] == "outside_service_coverage"
    late = req.data("check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=now(10)), expect=200)
    assert late["serviceable"] is False and late["reason"] == "deadline_unreachable", late
    r = req.call("check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=now(-10)))
    assert r.status_code == 400 and r.json()["code"] == "invalid_deadline"
    work = req.data("list-role-work", {})
    assert work["pending"] == [] and work["inProgress"] == [] and work["completed"] == []
    r = req.call("read-operations-state", {})
    assert r.status_code == 403

    print("== collection request")
    cr = req.data("create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType=amber["containerType"], temperatureMinC=amber["temperatureMinC"], temperatureMaxC=amber["temperatureMaxC"], earliestCollectionAt=now(-5), latestCollectionAt=now(90)), expect=201)
    assert cr["serviceability"] == "serviceable" and cr["journeyId"] and cr["activeAssignmentIds"], cr
    sample_id, journey_id = cr["sampleId"], cr["journeyId"]
    r = req.call("create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType="wrong", temperatureMinC=0, temperatureMaxC=1))
    assert r.status_code == 400 and r.json()["code"] == "handling_mismatch"
    state = req.data(f"read-sample-state/{sample_id}", method="GET")
    assert state["state"]["status"] == "pending_collection" and state["timeline"], state
    plan = req.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})
    assert plan["journeyId"] == journey_id and "workerId" not in (plan["legs"][0] if plan["legs"] else {})
    dplan = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})
    assert dplan["routeMode"] == "multi_stop" and len(dplan["legs"]) == 2 and dplan["planVersion"] == 1, dplan
    assert [s["stopType"] for s in dplan["orderedStops"]] == ["pickup", "handoff", "handoff", "delivery"], dplan["orderedStops"]

    print("== collection")
    col, _ = login(collector["username"], pw, "collection_professional")
    work = col.data("list-role-work", {})
    assert len(work["pending"]) == 1 and work["pending"][0]["kind"] == "collection", work
    col_asg = work["pending"][0]["assignmentId"]
    r = col.call("collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": col_asg, "collectedAt": now(), "containerType": amber["containerType"], "observedTemperatureC": amber["temperatureMinC"], "idempotencyKey": "k0"})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "collection_not_ready", r.text
    r = col.call("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg})
    assert r.status_code == 400 and r.json()["code"] == "idempotency_required"
    acc = col.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "idempotencyKey": f"acc-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert acc["status"] == "accepted"
    acc2 = col.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "idempotencyKey": f"acc-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert acc2 == acc
    r = col.call("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "idempotencyKey": f"acc-{tag}"}, )
    r = col.call("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "idempotencyKey": f"acc-{tag}-other"})
    assert r.status_code == 201  # already mine
    col.data("record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "coordinate": origin, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": now()}, expect=201)
    r = col.call("record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "coordinate": origin, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": now()})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "stale_location"
    sealed = col.data("collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": col_asg, "collectedAt": now(), "containerType": amber["containerType"], "observedTemperatureC": amber["temperatureMinC"], "idempotencyKey": f"seal-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert sealed["status"] == "sealed" and sealed["currentHolderId"] == collector["userId"] and sealed["handlingCompliant"] is True
    life = req.data("read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id})
    assert life["sealed"] is True and life["currentHolderId"] == collector["userId"] and life["status"] == "sealed"

    print("== transport legs with custody handoffs")
    def courier_client(worker_id):
        name = courier1["username"] if worker_id == courier1["userId"] else courier2["username"]
        return login(name, pw, "delivery_partner")[0]

    def handoff(sender, from_asg, receiver, to_asg, receiver_id, key):
        h = sender.data("initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": from_asg, "toAssignmentId": to_asg, "receiverId": receiver_id, "initiatedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"{key}-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        assert h["status"] == "pending"
        c = sender.data("confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h["handoffId"], "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"{key}s-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        assert c["status"] == "pending" and c["currentHolderId"] != receiver_id
        c = receiver.data("confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h["handoffId"], "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"{key}r-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        assert c["status"] == "confirmed" and c["currentHolderId"] == receiver_id, c
        c2 = receiver.data("confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h["handoffId"], "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"{key}r2-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        assert c2["currentHolderId"] == receiver_id  # repeated confirmation: no duplicate transfer
        return h

    def accept_node(client, key):
        w = client.data("list-role-work", {})
        items = [i for i in w["pending"] if i["sampleId"] == sample_id]
        assert len(items) == 1 and items[0]["kind"] in ("node", "laboratory"), w
        client.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": items[0]["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": f"{key}-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        return items[0]["assignmentId"]

    legs = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})["legs"]
    assert len(legs) == 3
    leg1 = legs[0]
    w1 = leg1["workerId"]
    cour = courier_client(w1)
    other = courier_client(courier2["userId"] if w1 == courier1["userId"] else courier1["userId"])
    r = other.call("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": "x"})

    cour.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": f"acc1-{tag}"}, expect=201)

    st = admin.data(f"read-sample-state/{sample_id}", method="GET")
    assert st["state"]["status"] == "in_transit" and st["locationStale"] is False

    print("== collection centre handling")
    cpc, _ = login(cpworker["username"], pw, "node_handler")
    cp_asg = accept_node(cpc, "cpn")
    handoff(cour, leg1["assignmentId"], cpc, cp_asg, cpworker["userId"], "h2")
    cour_work = cour.data("list-role-work", {})
    assert any(i["assignmentId"] == leg1["assignmentId"] for i in cour_work["completed"]), cour_work
    legs = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})["legs"]
    leg2 = legs[1]
    cour2 = courier_client(leg2["workerId"])
    cour2.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg2["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": f"acc2-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    handoff(cpc, cp_asg, cour2, leg2["assignmentId"], leg2["workerId"], "h3")
    cour2.data("update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg2["assignmentId"], "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"arr2-{tag}"}, expect=201)

    print("== hub handling + checkpoint")
    hubc, _ = login(hubworker["username"], pw, "node_handler")
    node_asg = accept_node(hubc, "hubn")
    handoff(cour2, leg2["assignmentId"], hubc, node_asg, hubworker["userId"], "h4")
    cp_ = hubc.data("record-handling-checkpoint", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": node_asg, "locationId": hub["locationId"], "containerType": amber["containerType"], "observedTemperatureC": amber["temperatureMaxC"], "recordedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"cp-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert cp_["compliant"] is True and cp_["sampleStatus"] == "at_node"
    hubcap = hubc.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": hub["locationId"], "capacityUnits": 12, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    assert hubcap["capacityUnits"] == 12
    r = hubc.call("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": lab["locationId"], "capacityUnits": 12})
    assert r.status_code == 403

    print("== final leg + laboratory receipt")
    legs = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})["legs"]
    leg3 = legs[2]
    cour3 = courier_client(leg3["workerId"])

    handoff(hubc, node_asg, cour3, leg3["assignmentId"], leg3["workerId"], "h5")
    cour3.data("update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg3["assignmentId"], "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"arr3-{tag}"}, expect=201)

    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "receipt_not_ready", r.text
    handoff(cour3, leg3["assignmentId"], labc, lab_asg, labworker["userId"], "h6")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end smoke test against a running application.

Usage: ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD=... python3 scripts/e2e_smoke.py [base_url]

Walks the full lifecycle: network setup, users, serviceability dry run,
collection request, assignment offers, collection + sealing, custody handoffs,
laboratory receipt, replanning and audit search.
"""
import os
import sys
import uuid
import random
import datetime as dt

import requests

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
API = BASE + "/api"
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")


def now(offset_minutes=0):
    return (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) + dt.timedelta(minutes=offset_minutes)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


class Client:
    def __init__(self, token=None):
        self.token = token

    def call(self, path, body=None, method="POST", expect=None):
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}"} if self.token else {}
        if method == "POST":
            r = requests.post(f"{API}/{path}", json=body if body is not None else {}, headers=headers)
        else:
            r = requests.get(f"{API}/{path}", headers=headers)
        if expect is not None and r.status_code != expect:
            raise AssertionError(f"{method} {path} -> {r.status_code} {r.text} (expected {expect})")
        return r

    def data(self, path, body=None, expect=None, method="POST"):
        r = self.call(path, body, method=method, expect=expect)
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            raise AssertionError(f"{path}: {r.status_code} {r.text}")
        return r.json()["data"]


def login(username, password, role=None):
    r = requests.post(f"{API}/authenticate-user", json={"username": username, "password": password})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    d = r.json()["data"]
    c = Client(d["sessionToken"])
    if role:
        c.data("select-active-role", {"role": role}, expect=200)
    return c, d


def main():
    print("== login admin")
    admin, info = login(ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
    assert "administrator" in info["roles"]
    if info["activeRole"] != "administrator":
        admin.data("select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"})
    assert requests.get(BASE + "/ready").json() == {"status": "ready"}
    # invalid credentials
    r = requests.post(f"{API}/authenticate-user", json={"username": ADMIN_USER, "password": "nope"})
    assert r.status_code == 401 and r.json()["code"] == "invalid_credentials"

    tag = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    BL, BO = 40 + random.random() * 20, -100 + random.random() * 60  # unique network region per run
    print("== network")
    cp = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Collection Centre {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": BL, "longitude": BO}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": 5, "active": True, "functions": ["collection_point", "transfer_point"]}, expect=201)
    hub = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Hub {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": BL + 0.01, "longitude": BO + 0.015}, "coverageKm": 3, "handlingMinutes": 10, "active": True, "functions": ["hub"]}, expect=201)
    lab = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Laboratory {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": BL + 0.02, "longitude": BO + 0.035}, "coverageKm": 2, "handlingMinutes": 5, "active": True, "functions": ["laboratory"]}, expect=201)
    for loc in (cp, hub, lab):
        admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": loc["locationId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    c1 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": cp["locationId"], "toLocationId": hub["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 20, "costUnits": 3, "cooled": True, "active": True}, expect=201)
    c2 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": hub["locationId"], "toLocationId": lab["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 25, "costUnits": 4, "cooled": True, "active": True}, expect=201)
    for c in (c1, c2):
        admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": c["connectionId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    catalog = admin.data("ui/catalog", method="GET")
    types = {t["name"]: t for t in catalog["sampleTypes"]}
    assert {"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"} <= set(types), types.keys()
    amber = types["Amber"]
    for t in types.values():
        admin.data("configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab["locationId"], "sampleTypeId": t["sampleTypeId"], "accepts": True}, expect=200)
    snap = admin.data("read-serviceability-snapshot", {})
    assert snap["status"] == "complete" and snap["activeCollectionPointCount"] >= 1

    print("== users")
    pw = "Passw0rd!"
    def mk(username, roles, **extra):
        body = {"username": username, "initialPassword": pw, "fullName": username, "roles": roles, "active": True}
        body.update(extra)
        return admin.data("create-user", body, expect=201)
    requester = mk(f"req_{tag}", ["requester"])
    collector = mk(f"col_{tag}", ["collection_professional"], qualifications=["amber"], certifications=[{"code": "amber", "active": True}])
    courier1 = mk(f"cour1_{tag}", ["delivery_partner"])
    courier2 = mk(f"cour2_{tag}", ["delivery_partner"])
    hubworker = mk(f"hub_{tag}", ["node_handler"], assignedLocationId=hub["locationId"])
    cpworker = mk(f"cp_{tag}", ["node_handler"], assignedLocationId=cp["locationId"])
    labworker = mk(f"lab_{tag}", ["laboratory_team", "requester"], assignedLocationId=lab["locationId"])
    r = admin.call("create-user", {"username": f"req_{tag}", "initialPassword": pw, "roles": ["requester"], "active": True})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "username_exists"

    print("== multi-role selection")
    labc, labinfo = login(labworker["username"], pw)
    assert labinfo["activeRole"] == "" and set(labinfo["roles"]) == {"laboratory_team", "requester"}
    r = labc.call("list-role-work", {})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "role_not_selected", r.text
    r = labc.call("select-active-role", {"role": "dispatcher"})
    assert r.status_code == 403 and r.json()["code"] == "role_not_held"
    sel = labc.data("select-active-role", {"role": "laboratory_team"}, expect=200)
    assert sel["activeRole"] == "laboratory_team" and set(sel["roles"]) == {"laboratory_team", "requester"}
    boot = labc.data("ui/bootstrap", method="GET")
    assert boot["user"]["activeRole"] == "laboratory_team" and boot["user"]["roleSelectionRequired"] is False

    print("== serviceability dry run")
    req, _ = login(requester["username"], pw, "requester")
    origin = {"latitude": BL + 0.0015, "longitude": BO + 0.003}
    body = {"origin": origin, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": amber["sampleTypeId"], "requestedAt": now(), "deliveryDeadline": now(240)}
    sv = req.data("check-serviceability", body, expect=200)
    assert sv["serviceable"] is True and sv["reason"] == "serviceable" and sv["targetLaboratoryId"] == lab["locationId"], sv
    far = req.data("check-serviceability", dict(body, origin={"latitude": BL + 1.5, "longitude": BO + 1.5}), expect=200)
    assert far["serviceable"] is False and far["reason"] == "outside_service_coverage"
    late = req.data("check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=now(10)), expect=200)
    assert late["serviceable"] is False and late["reason"] == "deadline_unreachable", late
    r = req.call("check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=now(-10)))
    assert r.status_code == 400 and r.json()["code"] == "invalid_deadline"
    work = req.data("list-role-work", {})
    assert work["pending"] == [] and work["inProgress"] == [] and work["completed"] == []
    r = req.call("read-operations-state", {})
    assert r.status_code == 403

    print("== collection request")
    cr = req.data("create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType=amber["containerType"], temperatureMinC=amber["temperatureMinC"], temperatureMaxC=amber["temperatureMaxC"], earliestCollectionAt=now(-5), latestCollectionAt=now(90)), expect=201)
    assert cr["serviceability"] == "serviceable" and cr["journeyId"] and cr["activeAssignmentIds"], cr
    sample_id, journey_id = cr["sampleId"], cr["journeyId"]
    r = req.call("create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType="wrong", temperatureMinC=0, temperatureMaxC=1))
    assert r.status_code == 400 and r.json()["code"] == "handling_mismatch"
    state = req.data(f"read-sample-state/{sample_id}", method="GET")
    assert state["state"]["status"] == "pending_collection" and state["timeline"], state
    plan = req.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})
    assert plan["journeyId"] == journey_id and "workerId" not in (plan["legs"][0] if plan["legs"] else {})
    dplan = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})
    assert dplan["routeMode"] == "multi_stop" and len(dplan["legs"]) == 3 and dplan["planVersion"] == 1, dplan
    assert [s["stopType"] for s in dplan["orderedStops"]] == ["pickup", "handoff", "handoff", "delivery"], dplan["orderedStops"]

    print("== collection")
    col, _ = login(collector["username"], pw, "collection_professional")
    work = col.data("list-role-work", {})
    assert len(work["pending"]) == 1 and work["pending"][0]["kind"] == "collection", work
    col_asg = work["pending"][0]["assignmentId"]
    r = col.call("collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": col_asg, "collectedAt": now(), "containerType": amber["containerType"], "observedTemperatureC": amber["temperatureMinC"], "idempotencyKey": "k0"})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "collection_not_ready", r.text
    r = col.call("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg})
    assert r.status_code == 400 and r.json()["code"] == "idempotency_required"
    acc = col.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "idempotencyKey": f"acc-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert acc["status"] == "accepted"
    acc2 = col.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "idempotencyKey": f"acc-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert acc2 == acc
    r = col.call("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "idempotencyKey": f"acc-{tag}"}, )
    r = col.call("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "idempotencyKey": f"acc-{tag}-other"})
    assert r.status_code == 201  # already mine
    col.data("record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "coordinate": origin, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": now()}, expect=201)
    r = col.call("record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": col_asg, "coordinate": origin, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": now()})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "stale_location"
    sealed = col.data("collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": col_asg, "collectedAt": now(), "containerType": amber["containerType"], "observedTemperatureC": amber["temperatureMinC"], "idempotencyKey": f"seal-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert sealed["status"] == "sealed" and sealed["currentHolderId"] == collector["userId"] and sealed["handlingCompliant"] is True
    life = req.data("read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id})
    assert life["sealed"] is True and life["currentHolderId"] == collector["userId"] and life["status"] == "sealed"

    print("== transport legs with custody handoffs")
    def courier_client(worker_id):
        name = courier1["username"] if worker_id == courier1["userId"] else courier2["username"]
        return login(name, pw, "delivery_partner")[0]

    def handoff(sender, from_asg, receiver, to_asg, receiver_id, key):
        h = sender.data("initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": from_asg, "toAssignmentId": to_asg, "receiverId": receiver_id, "initiatedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"{key}-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        assert h["status"] == "pending"
        c = sender.data("confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h["handoffId"], "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"{key}s-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        assert c["status"] == "pending" and c["currentHolderId"] != receiver_id
        c = receiver.data("confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h["handoffId"], "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"{key}r-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        assert c["status"] == "confirmed" and c["currentHolderId"] == receiver_id, c
        c2 = receiver.data("confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h["handoffId"], "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"{key}r2-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        assert c2["currentHolderId"] == receiver_id  # repeated confirmation: no duplicate transfer
        return h

    def accept_node(client, key):
        w = client.data("list-role-work", {})
        items = [i for i in w["pending"] if i["sampleId"] == sample_id]
        assert len(items) == 1 and items[0]["kind"] in ("node", "laboratory"), w
        client.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": items[0]["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": f"{key}-{tag}"}, expect=201)
        return items[0]["assignmentId"]

    legs = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})["legs"]
    assert len(legs) == 3
    leg1 = legs[0]
    w1 = leg1["workerId"]
    cour = courier_client(w1)
    other = courier_client(courier2["userId"] if w1 == courier1["userId"] else courier1["userId"])
    r = other.call("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": "x"})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "offer_not_offered", r.text
    cour.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": f"acc1-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    wplan = cour.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})
    assert wplan["scope"] == "assigned_legs" and leg1["assignmentId"] in wplan["assignmentIds"]
    r = cour.call("update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1["assignmentId"], "status": "picked_up", "occurredAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"pu-early-{tag}"})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] in ("custody_required", "prior_leg_incomplete"), r.text
    handoff(col, col_asg, cour, leg1["assignmentId"], w1, "h1")
    cour.data("update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1["assignmentId"], "status": "in_transit", "occurredAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"it-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    cour.data("record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": leg1["assignmentId"], "coordinate": {"latitude": BL + 0.001, "longitude": BO + 0.001}, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": now()}, expect=201)
    cour.data("update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1["assignmentId"], "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"arr-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    st = admin.data(f"read-sample-state/{sample_id}", method="GET")
    assert st["state"]["status"] == "in_transit" and st["locationStale"] is False

    print("== collection centre handling")
    cpc, _ = login(cpworker["username"], pw, "node_handler")
    cp_asg = accept_node(cpc, "cpn")
    handoff(cour, leg1["assignmentId"], cpc, cp_asg, cpworker["userId"], "h2")
    cour_work = cour.data("list-role-work", {})
    assert any(i["assignmentId"] == leg1["assignmentId"] for i in cour_work["completed"]), cour_work
    legs = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})["legs"]
    leg2 = legs[1]
    cour2 = courier_client(leg2["workerId"])
    cour2.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg2["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": f"acc2-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    handoff(cpc, cp_asg, cour2, leg2["assignmentId"], leg2["workerId"], "h3")
    cour2.data("update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg2["assignmentId"], "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"arr2-{tag}"}, expect=201)

    print("== hub handling + checkpoint")
    hubc, _ = login(hubworker["username"], pw, "node_handler")
    node_asg = accept_node(hubc, "hubn")
    handoff(cour2, leg2["assignmentId"], hubc, node_asg, hubworker["userId"], "h4")
    cp_ = hubc.data("record-handling-checkpoint", {"sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": node_asg, "locationId": hub["locationId"], "containerType": amber["containerType"], "observedTemperatureC": amber["temperatureMaxC"], "recordedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"cp-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert cp_["compliant"] is True and cp_["sampleStatus"] == "at_node"
    hubcap = hubc.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": hub["locationId"], "capacityUnits": 12, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    assert hubcap["capacityUnits"] == 12
    r = hubc.call("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": lab["locationId"], "capacityUnits": 12})
    assert r.status_code == 403

    print("== final leg + laboratory receipt")
    legs = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})["legs"]
    leg3 = legs[2]
    cour3 = courier_client(leg3["workerId"])
    cour3.data("accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg3["assignmentId"], "idempotencyKey": f"acc3-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    handoff(hubc, node_asg, cour3, leg3["assignmentId"], leg3["workerId"], "h5")
    cour3.data("update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg3["assignmentId"], "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"arr3-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    lab_asg = accept_node(labc, "labn")
    r = labc.call("confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample_id, "laboratoryId": lab["locationId"], "receivedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"rc-early-{tag}"})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "receipt_not_ready", r.text
    handoff(cour3, leg3["assignmentId"], labc, lab_asg, labworker["userId"], "h6")
    rc = labc.data("confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample_id, "laboratoryId": lab["locationId"], "receivedAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"rc-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert rc["status"] == "received"
    life = req.data("read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id})

    plan = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id})

    rw = req.data("list-role-work", {})

    statuses = [e["action"] for e in life["timeline"] if e["action"].startswith("sample.status.")]
    assert statuses[0] == "sample.status.pending_collection" and statuses[-1] == "sample.status.received", statuses


    print("== audit")
    audit = admin.data("search-audit-trail", {"entityId": sample_id, "limit": 50, "order": "oldest_first"})
    assert audit["total"] >= 5 and audit["entries"][0]["actorRole"] and audit["order"] == "oldest_first"
    audit2 = admin.data("search-audit-trail", {"query": "custody", "limit": 5})
    assert audit2["returned"] <= 5 and all("custody" in e["action"] for e in audit2["entries"]), audit2
    logins = admin.data("search-audit-trail", {"action": "auth.login", "success": False})
    assert logins["total"] >= 1

    print("== operations + disruption/replan")
    cr2 = req.data("create-collection-request", dict(body, containerType=amber["containerType"], temperatureMinC=amber["temperatureMinC"], temperatureMaxC=amber["temperatureMaxC"]), expect=201)
    j2 = cr2["journeyId"]
    ops = admin.data("read-operations-state", {})
    assert any(s["sampleId"] == cr2["sampleId"] for s in ops["samples"]) and ops["workers"] and ops["locations"]
    plan2 = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": j2})
    r = admin.call("reroute-journey", {"journeyId": j2, "expectedPlanVersion": 99, "idempotencyKey": f"rr0-{tag}"})
    assert r.status_code == 409 and r.json()["code"] == "stale_plan"
    # Add an alternate path cp -> lab so the hub can be disrupted.
    c3 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": cp["locationId"], "toLocationId": lab["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 60, "costUnits": 9, "cooled": False, "active": True}, expect=201)
    admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": c3["connectionId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 0}, expect=200)
    dis = admin.data("report-disruption", {"resourceType": "node", "resourceId": hub["locationId"], "reason": "power outage", "occurredAt": now(), "idempotencyKey": f"dis-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert cr2["sampleId"] in dis["affectedSampleIds"] and dis["replanStatus"] == "replaced", dis
    old = admin.data("read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": j2})
    assert old["status"] == "replaced" and old["replacementJourney"]["status"] == "active", old["status"]
    new_plan = old["replacementJourney"]
    assert len(new_plan["legs"]) == 1 and new_plan["parentJourneyId"] == j2
    st2 = req.data(f"read-sample-state/{cr2['sampleId']}", method="GET")
    assert st2["activeJourneyId"] == new_plan["journeyId"]
    admin.data("set-location-status", {"locationId": hub["locationId"], "active": True}, expect=200)
    canc = admin.data("cancel-journey", {"journeyId": new_plan["journeyId"], "expectedPlanVersion": new_plan["planVersion"], "reason": "test", "idempotencyKey": f"can-{tag}"}, expect=201)
    assert canc["status"] == "cancelled"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end smoke test against a running application.

Usage: ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD=... python3 scripts/e2e_smoke.py [base_url]

Walks the full lifecycle: network setup, users, serviceability dry run,
collection request, assignment offers, collection + sealing, custody handoffs,
laboratory receipt, replanning and audit search.
"""
import os
import sys
import uuid
import random
import datetime as dt

import requests

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
API = BASE + "/api"
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")


def now(offset_minutes=0):
    return (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) + dt.timedelta(minutes=offset_minutes)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


class Client:
    def __init__(self, token=None):
        self.token = token

    def call(self, path, body=None, method="POST", expect=None):
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}"} if self.token else {}
        if method == "POST":
            r = requests.post(f"{API}/{path}", json=body if body is not None else {}, headers=headers)
        else:
            r = requests.get(f"{API}/{path}", headers=headers)
        if expect is not None and r.status_code != expect:
            raise AssertionError(f"{method} {path} -> {r.status_code} {r.text} (expected {expect})")
        return r

    def data(self, path, body=None, expect=None, method="POST"):
        r = self.call(path, body, method=method, expect=expect)
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            raise AssertionError(f"{path}: {r.status_code} {r.text}")
        return r.json()["data"]


def login(username, password, role=None):
    r = requests.post(f"{API}/authenticate-user", json={"username": username, "password": password})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    d = r.json()["data"]
    c = Client(d["sessionToken"])
    if role:
        c.data("select-active-role", {"role": role}, expect=200)
    return c, d


def main():
    print("== login admin")
    admin, info = login(ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
    assert "administrator" in info["roles"]
    if info["activeRole"] != "administrator":
        admin.data("select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"})
    assert requests.get(BASE + "/ready").json() == {"status": "ready"}
    # invalid credentials
    r = requests.post(f"{API}/authenticate-user", json={"username": ADMIN_USER, "password": "nope"})
    assert r.status_code == 401 and r.json()["code"] == "invalid_credentials"

    tag = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    BL, BO = 40 + random.random() * 20, -100 + random.random() * 60  # unique network region per run
    print("== network")
    cp = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Collection Centre {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": BL, "longitude": BO}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": 5, "active": True, "functions": ["collection_point", "transfer_point"]}, expect=201)
    hub = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Hub {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": BL + 0.01, "longitude": BO + 0.015}, "coverageKm": 3, "handlingMinutes": 10, "active": True, "functions": ["hub"]}, expect=201)
    lab = admin.data("create-location", {"name": f"Laboratory {tag}", "coordinate": {"latitude": BL + 0.02, "longitude": BO + 0.035}, "coverageKm": 2, "handlingMinutes": 5, "active": True, "functions": ["laboratory"]}, expect=201)
    for loc in (cp, hub, lab):
        admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": loc["locationId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)
    c1 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": cp["locationId"], "toLocationId": hub["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 20, "costUnits": 3, "cooled": True, "active": True}, expect=201)
    c2 = admin.data("create-connection", {"fromLocationId": hub["locationId"], "toLocationId": lab["locationId"], "travelMinutes": 25, "costUnits": 4, "cooled": True, "active": True}, expect=201)

        admin.data("configure-capacity", {"resourceId": c["connectionId"], "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, expect=200)

    amber = types["Amber"]

        admin.data("configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab["locationId"], "sampleTypeId": t["sampleTypeId"], "accepts": True}, expect=200)
    snap = admin.data("read-serviceability-snapshot", {})
    assert snap["status"] == "complete" and snap["activeCollectionPointCount"] >= 1

    print("== users")

    print("== serviceability dry run")

    col_asg = work["pending"][0]["assignmentId"]

## Layout
- `backend/` Go module `labsample` (Go 1.25). `cmd/server` entrypoint (`--reset` flag materialises schema and exits).
  - `internal/core` domain services (auth, admin, requests, planning/network, assign, work, journeys, views, monitor).
  - `internal/httpapi` router (`server.go`), realtime events (`events.go`).
  - `internal/db/schema.sql` full PostgreSQL schema (only datastore used).
- `frontend/` React + TypeScript (Vite), MapLibre GL with local PMTiles served at `/map-assets/`.
- `app-setup/` manifest, openapi.json, build/start/reset scripts.
- `scripts/e2e_smoke.py` end-to-end API test (needs running app; `requests` available in /opt/arena/venv).
- `contracts/openapi.contract.json` is the pinned API contract — do not deviate.

## Environment
- Datastores: `sudo /opt/arena/bin/start-services.sh` starts PostgreSQL (postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena), MongoDB, Redis.
- Go deps vendored in /opt/arena/dependencies (GOFLAGS/GOPROXY preconfigured); frontend deps in /opt/arena/dependencies/frontend.
- Terminal tool: one command per call (chain with `&&`).

## Conventions
- All API responses wrap success in `{"data": ...}`; errors are `{"error","code"}`.
- Session tokens are opaque (table `sessions`); active role is per-session.
- Audit log is the sample timeline source (`audit_log.sample_ids`); `sample.status.<status>` actions are status changes.
- Planner: first mile home→entry node is a transport leg; node assignment at each intermediate node; laboratory assignment at the end.
- Replanning creates a replacement journey (`parent_journey_id`), preserving finished/in-progress assignments via `preserved_assignment_ids`.

## Testing
- `cd backend && go build ./... && go vet ./...`
- Start app, then `python3 scripts/e2e_smoke.py` (expects ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD env, default admin/admin123). Works on a used DB (retires old workers, random region).

# Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery — repository notes

## Layout
- `backend/` Go module `labsample` (Go 1.25). `cmd/server` entrypoint (`--reset` flag materialises schema and exits).
  - `internal/core` domain services (auth, admin, requests, planning/network, assign, work, journeys, views, monitor).
  - `internal/httpapi` router (`server.go`), realtime events (`events.go`).
  - `internal/db/schema.sql` full PostgreSQL schema (only datastore used).
- `frontend/` React + TypeScript (Vite), MapLibre GL with local PMTiles served at `/map-assets/`.
- `app-setup/` manifest, openapi.json, build/start/reset scripts.
- `scripts/e2e_smoke.py` end-to-end API test (needs running app; `requests` available in /opt/arena/venv).
- `contracts/openapi.contract.json` is the pinned API contract — do not deviate.

## Environment
- Datastores: `sudo /opt/arena/bin/start-services.sh` starts PostgreSQL (postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena), MongoDB, Redis.
- Go deps vendored in /opt/arena/dependencies (GOFLAGS/GOPROXY preconfigured); frontend deps in /opt/arena/dependencies/frontend.
- Terminal tool: one command per call (chain with `&&`).

## Conventions
- All API responses wrap success in `{"data": ...}`; errors are `{"error","code"}`.
- Session tokens are opaque (table `sessions`); active role is per-session.
- Audit log is the sample timeline source (`audit_log.sample_ids`); `sample.status.<status>` actions are status changes.
- Planner: first mile home→entry node is a transport leg; node assignment at each intermediate node; laboratory assignment at the end.
- Replanning creates a replacement journey (`parent_journey_id`), preserving finished/in-progress assignments via `preserved_assignment_ids`.

## Testing
- `cd backend && go build ./... && go vet ./...`
- Start app, then `python3 scripts/e2e_smoke.py` (expects ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD env, default admin/admin123). Works on a used DB (retires old workers, random region).
package config

import (
        "os"
        "strconv"
        "time"
)

type Config struct {
        Port          string
        DatabaseURL   string
        AdminUsername string
        AdminPassword string
        StaticDir     string
        MapAssetsDir  string

        OfferTimeout         time.Duration
        NoWorkerGrace        time.Duration
        LocationStaleAfter   time.Duration
        DeclinePenaltyWindow time.Duration
        DeclinePenaltyCount  int
        ClockSkew            time.Duration
}

func Load() Config {
        return Config{
                Port:                 env("PORT", "8080"),
                DatabaseURL:          env("DATABASE_URL", "postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable"),
                AdminUsername:        env("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin"),
                AdminPassword:        env("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin"),
                StaticDir:            env("STATIC_DIR", "frontend/dist"),
                MapAssetsDir:         env("MAP_ASSETS_DIR", "/opt/arena/map-assets"),
                OfferTimeout:         envDuration("OFFER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", 90),
                NoWorkerGrace:        envDuration("NO_WORKER_GRACE_SECONDS", 60),
                LocationStaleAfter:   envDuration("LOCATION_STALE_SECONDS", 600),
                DeclinePenaltyWindow: envDuration("DECLINE_PENALTY_WINDOW_SECONDS", 1800),
                DeclinePenaltyCount:  envInt("DECLINE_PENALTY_COUNT", 3),
                ClockSkew:            envDuration("CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS", 300),
        }
}

func env(key, def string) string {
        if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
                return v
        }
        return def
}

func envInt(key string, def int) int {
        if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
                if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil {
                        return n
                }
        }
        return def
}

func envDuration(key string, defSeconds int) time.Duration {
        return time.Duration(envInt(key, defSeconds)) * time.Second
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds the Go backend binary and the React frontend bundle. Run from /workspace.
set -u
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT" || exit 1

echo "==> building backend"
(cd backend && go build -o bin/server ./cmd/server) || exit 1

echo "==> installing frontend dependencies"
if [ -d frontend/node_modules ]; then
  (cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline) || exit 1
else
  (cd frontend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund) || (cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund) || exit 1
fi

echo "==> building frontend"
(cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npx vite build) || exit 1

echo "==> build complete"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate app-setup/openapi.json from the pinned contract, adding descriptions only.

Paths, methods, schemas, status codes and operationIds are copied verbatim.
"""
import copy
import json
import pathlib

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SRC = ROOT / "contracts" / "openapi.contract.json"
DST = ROOT / "app-setup" / "openapi.json"

DESCRIPTIONS = {
    "authenticate_user": ("Sign in", "Authenticates a user with username and password and returns an opaque bearer session token, the roles held, and the active role. When the account holds several roles the active role must be chosen with select_active_role before role-scoped operations. The first administrator is created from ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD on first start."),
    "select_active_role": ("Select active role", "Switches the session's active role to one of the roles the account holds. Permissions and work views use the selected role. Switching never adds or removes roles."),
    "read_ui_bootstrap": ("UI bootstrap", "Returns the signed-in user, server time and role-specific bootstrap data (requester samples, or the operations state for dispatchers/administrators)."),
    "read_user": ("Read user", "Returns a user profile with roles, qualifications and certifications. Users may read themselves; administrators and dispatchers may read anyone."),
    "create_user": ("Create user", "Administrator only. Creates a user with roles, collector qualifications, certifications and (for node handlers / laboratory operators) the assigned node or laboratory."),
    "update_user_access": ("Update user access", "Administrator only. Replaces a user's roles, qualifications, certifications, active flag and assigned location."),
    "create_location": ("Create location", "Administrator only. Creates a network location that may act as collection point, transfer point, hub and/or laboratory. coverageKm (max 5) defines the serviceable radius for collection points."),
    "update_location": ("Update location", "Administrator only. Updates a location's name, coordinate, coverage, handling time and functions. Publishes a new serviceability snapshot version."),
    "set_location_status": ("Activate/deactivate location", "Administrator only. Activates or deactivates a whole location without restart. Deactivation triggers replanning of unfinished work that depends on it."),
    "set_location_function_status": ("Activate/deactivate location function", "Administrator only. Toggles a single function (collection_point, transfer_point, hub, laboratory) at a location."),
    "create_connection": ("Create connection", "Administrator only. Creates a directed transport connection between two locations with travel time, cost, cooled capability and active flag."),
    "set_connection_status": ("Activate/deactivate connection", "Administrator only. Toggles a transport connection; deactivation replans unfinished journeys that use it."),
    "configure_capacity": ("Configure capacity", "Sets regular and cooled capacity units for a location or connection. Administrators may configure any resource; node handlers and laboratory operators only their assigned location. Rejected with capacity_reserved when the new value is below current reservations."),
    "configure_laboratory_acceptance": ("Configure laboratory acceptance", "Administrator only. Declares whether a laboratory accepts a sample type."),
    "create_sample_type": ("Create sample type", "Administrator only. Creates a sample type with container, temperature range, qualified-collector requirement, incompatibilities, cooled-route requirement and batching permission."),
    "update_sample_type": ("Update sample type", "Administrator only. Updates handling attributes of an existing sample type."),
    "check_serviceability": ("Check serviceability (dry run)", "Evaluates whether an origin and sample type can be serviced before a deadline against the published serviceability snapshot. Creates nothing: no request, sample, journey, assignment or capacity reservation."),
    "read_serviceability_snapshot": ("Read serviceability snapshot", "Returns the currently published, complete serviceability-calculation version with the active collection-point regions."),
    "create_collection_request": ("Create collection request", "Creates a home/clinic/node collection request and its sample, plans the journey, reserves capacity and offers the first assignments. Requesters create requests for themselves; dispatchers/administrators may pass requesterId."),
    "ingest_presealed_sample": ("Register pre-sealed sample", "Registers a sample already collected and sealed by the caller (who becomes current holder). Origin must be a clinic or node. Only the transport legs from the registration point onward are created."),
    "read_sample_state": ("Read sample state", "Returns a sample's request details, serviceability, active assignments, status, timeline, latest location and staleness. Requesters see only their own samples."),
    "read_sample_lifecycle": ("Read sample lifecycle", "Returns a sample's custody and lifecycle view: status, sealed flag, completed legs, active replacement plans, current holder, pending handoff and exception."),
    "list_role_work": ("List role work", "Returns pending, in-progress and completed work for the session's active role (or a held role passed explicitly)."),
    "read_journey_plan": ("Read journey plan", "Returns the journey plan. Dispatchers/administrators receive the full plan, workers the legs assigned to them (scope assigned_legs), requesters a reduced view."),
    "accept_assignment": ("Accept assignment", "Accepts an assignment offered to the calling worker. Only the worker it was offered to may accept; offers that timed out are re-offered."),
    "decline_assignment": ("Decline assignment", "Declines an offered assignment; it is re-offered to the next eligible worker. Repeated declines temporarily lower offer priority but never exclude the worker."),
    "set_worker_availability": ("Set worker availability", "Sets a worker's availability and capacity units. Workers may set their own; dispatchers/administrators any worker."),
    "record_worker_location": ("Record worker location", "Records a worker's current coordinate for an active assignment with a monotonically increasing sequence."),
    "update_assignment_progress": ("Update assignment progress", "Records progress on an accepted assignment (at_pickup, picked_up, in_transit, arrived, delivered, in_progress, completed). Pickup requires custody; delivery requires pickup."),
    "collect_and_seal_sample": ("Collect and seal sample", "Certified collection professional records collection and sealing within the collection window, with the observed container and temperature. The collector becomes current holder."),
    "record_handling_checkpoint": ("Record handling checkpoint", "The current holder records the observed container and temperature. Out-of-range observations mark the sample as an exception."),
    "initiate_handoff": ("Initiate handoff", "The current holder initiates a custody transfer to the worker of the next adjacent assignment. Custody changes only once both sides confirm."),
    "confirm_handoff": ("Confirm handoff", "Sender or receiver confirms a pending handoff. When both have confirmed the receiver becomes current holder; repeated confirmations are idempotent."),
    "confirm_laboratory_receipt": ("Confirm laboratory receipt", "Laboratory intake operator of the target laboratory confirms receipt, completing the journey and releasing capacity."),
    "record_laboratory_exception": ("Record laboratory exception", "Laboratory intake operator records that a sample cannot be accepted normally; the sample is marked as an exception."),
    "read_operations_state": ("Read operations state", "Dispatcher/administrator monitoring view: samples with holder and staleness, workers, locations, connections, routes, handoffs, delays and exceptions."),
    "edit_active_plan": ("Edit active plan", "Dispatcher/administrator applies a change (stop edits, worker replacement, merge/split, reroute, cancel) to an unfinished journey with a plan-version check. Invalid changes are rejected and the current plan kept."),
    "split_journey": ("Split journey", "Moves the given samples from a batched journey into a new journey; completed work is preserved."),
    "merge_journeys": ("Merge journeys", "Merges whole source journeys into a target journey when samples, containers, temperatures, capacity and deadlines are compatible."),
    "cancel_journey": ("Cancel journey", "Cancels unfinished work on a journey, releasing reservations; completed work and custody are not rewritten."),
    "reroute_journey": ("Reroute journey", "Replans unfinished work of a journey, producing a single replacement plan, or marking the sample expired/exception when no valid route remains."),
    "report_disruption": ("Report disruption", "Reports that a location, connection, route, worker or capacity pool is unavailable; affected unfinished journeys are replanned."),
    "search_audit_trail": ("Search audit trail", "Dispatcher/administrator search over the audit log (sign-ins, permission checks, offers, custody, routes, capacity, exceptions, completion) with filters and pagination."),
    "stream_realtime_events": ("Realtime events", "WebSocket (subprotocol lab-logistics-v1, token as base64url bearer.<token> subprotocol) or HTTP poll of durable realtime events after the given sequence."),
    "system_readiness": ("Readiness", "Returns {\"status\":\"ready\"} only when the application can serve requests and reach PostgreSQL."),
}


def main():
    doc = copy.deepcopy(json.loads(SRC.read_text()))
    doc["info"] = {
        "title": "Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery API",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "description": "HTTP API for the lab sample pickup and delivery system. All successful responses wrap their payload in a data object; errors return {error, code}. Authenticate with authenticate_user and send the session token as a Bearer token.",
    }
    doc["servers"] = [{"url": "http://127.0.0.1:8080"}]
    doc["components"]["securitySchemes"]["BearerAuth"]["description"] = "Opaque session token returned by authenticate_user, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>."
    tags = {}
    for path, methods in doc["paths"].items():
        for method, op in methods.items():
            if method not in ("get", "post", "put", "patch", "delete"):
                continue
            oid = op["operationId"]
            summary, desc = DESCRIPTIONS[oid]
            op["summary"] = summary
            op["description"] = desc
            for code, resp in op["responses"].items():
                if not resp.get("description"):
                    resp["description"] = RESP_DESC.get(code, "Response")
    DST.write_text(json.dumps(doc, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("wrote", DST)


RESP_DESC = {
    "101": "WebSocket upgrade",
    "200": "Success",
    "201": "Created / applied",
    "400": "Validation error",
    "401": "Missing or invalid session",
    "403": "Active role not permitted or wrong actor",
    "404": "Entity not found",
    "405": "Method not allowed",
    "409": "State conflict",
    "500": "Internal error",
    "503": "Not ready",
}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Browser smoke test for the UI contract scenarios. Requires a running app and a prior
run of scripts/e2e_smoke.py (which creates the users referenced below).

  PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=... python ui_smoke.py <tag>
"""
import os
import re
import sys

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")
TAG = sys.argv[1]
PW = "Passw0rd!"


def login(page, username, password):
    page.goto(BASE + "/")
    page.get_by_label("Username").fill(username)
    page.get_by_label("Password").fill(password)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").click()


def main():
    external = []
    console_errors = []
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch()
        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 900})
        page = ctx.new_page()
        page.on("request", lambda r: external.append(r.url) if not r.url.startswith(BASE) and not r.url.startswith("data:") else None)
        page.on("console", lambda m: console_errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)

        print("== login rejects invalid credentials")
        login(page, ADMIN_USER, "wrong")
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        assert "invalid" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower()

        print("== admin login, monitor dashboard, map, audit")
        login(page, ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Administrator"
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Monitor").click()
        for cat in ["Samples", "Workers", "Locations", "Connections", "Exceptions"]:
            page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile(cat)).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Map").click()
        page.locator("canvas").first.wait_for(timeout=20000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Audit").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        page.get_by_role("row").nth(1).wait_for()
        rows_before = page.get_by_role("row").count()
        page.get_by_label("Action").fill("auth.login")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        assert page.get_by_role("row").count() > 1
        print("   audit rows", rows_before)
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()
        page.goto(BASE + "/monitor")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()

        print("== multi-role user: role switch control")
        login(page, f"lab_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Select the role")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Laboratory intake operator").click()
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Laboratory intake operator"
        sel = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Active role")
        opts = sel.locator("option").all_inner_texts()
        assert "Requester" in opts and "Laboratory intake operator" in opts, opts
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Facility").click()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Regular capacity|Capacity")).first.wait_for()
        sel.select_option(label="Requester")
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Requester"
        opts2 = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Active role").locator("option").all_inner_texts()
        assert opts == opts2, (opts, opts2)

        print("== requester: form validation + serviceability dry run")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="New request").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("Check serviceability")).click()
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        print("== requester with samples: work view + sample view")
        login(page, f"req_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name="My work").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Completed")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Current|In progress|Pending")).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile("Sample")).first.click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Status timeline|History")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Custodian|Current holder")).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Location (fresh|stale)|fresh|stale", re.I)).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Route progress", re.I)).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        print("== courier: work list and location write-through")
        login(page, f"cour1_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Completed")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        browser.close()
    bad = [u for u in external if not u.startswith("http://127.0.0.1")]
    assert not bad, f"external requests: {bad[:5]}"
    real_errors = [e for e in console_errors if "favicon" not in e]
    print("console errors:", real_errors[:5])
    print("UI OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Browser smoke test for the UI contract scenarios. Requires a running app and a prior
run of scripts/e2e_smoke.py (which creates the users referenced below).

  PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=... python ui_smoke.py <tag>
"""
import os
import re
import sys

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")
TAG = sys.argv[1]
PW = "Passw0rd!"


def login(page, username, password):
    page.goto(BASE + "/")
    page.get_by_label("Username").fill(username)
    page.get_by_label("Password").fill(password)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").click()


def main():
    external = []
    console_errors = []
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch()
        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 900})
        page = ctx.new_page()
        page.on("request", lambda r: external.append(r.url) if not r.url.startswith(BASE) and not r.url.startswith("data:") else None)
        page.on("console", lambda m: console_errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)

        print("== login rejects invalid credentials")
        login(page, ADMIN_USER, "wrong")
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        assert "invalid" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower()

        print("== admin login, monitor dashboard, map, audit")
        login(page, ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Administrator"
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Monitor").click()
        for cat in ["Samples", "Workers", "Locations", "Connections", "Exceptions"]:
            page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile(cat)).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Map").click()
        page.locator("canvas").first.wait_for(timeout=20000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Audit").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        page.get_by_role("row").nth(1).wait_for()
        rows_before = page.get_by_role("row").count()
        page.get_by_label("Action").fill("auth.login")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        assert page.get_by_role("row").count() > 1
        print("   audit rows", rows_before)
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()
        page.goto(BASE + "/monitor")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()

        print("== multi-role user: role switch control")
        login(page, f"lab_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Select the role")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Laboratory intake operator").click()
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Laboratory intake operator"
        sel = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Active role")
        opts = sel.locator("option").all_inner_texts()
        assert "Requester" in opts and "Laboratory intake operator" in opts, opts
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Facility").click()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Regular capacity|Capacity")).first.wait_for()
        sel.select_option(label="Requester")
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Requester"
        opts2 = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Active role").locator("option").all_inner_texts()
        assert opts == opts2, (opts, opts2)

        print("== requester: form validation + serviceability dry run")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="New request").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("Check serviceability")).click()
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        print("== requester with samples: work view + sample view")
        login(page, f"req_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name="My work").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Completed")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Current|In progress|Pending")).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile("Sample")).first.click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Status timeline|History")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Custodian|Current holder")).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Location (fresh|stale)|fresh|stale", re.I)).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Route progress", re.I)).first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        print("== courier: work list and location write-through")
        login(page, f"cour1_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Completed")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        browser.close()
    bad = [u for u in external if not u.startswith("http://127.0.0.1")]
    assert not bad, f"external requests: {bad[:5]}"
    real_errors = [e for e in console_errors if "favicon" not in e]
    print("console errors:", real_errors[:5])
    print("UI OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
