#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Browser smoke test for the UI contract scenarios. Requires a running app and a prior
run of scripts/e2e_smoke.py (which creates the users referenced below).

  PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=... python ui_smoke.py <tag>
"""
import os
import re
import sys

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN_USER = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASS = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")
TAG = sys.argv[1]
PW = "Passw0rd!"


def login(page, username, password):
    page.goto(BASE + "/")
    page.get_by_label("Username").fill(username)
    page.get_by_label("Password").fill(password)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").click()


def main():
    external = []
    console_errors = []
    map_assets = []
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch()
        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 900})
        page = ctx.new_page()
        page.on("request", lambda r: external.append(r.url) if not r.url.startswith(BASE) and not r.url.startswith("data:") else None)
        page.on("response", lambda r: map_assets.append((r.url, r.status)) if "/map-assets/" in r.url else None)
        page.on("console", lambda m: console_errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)

        print("== login rejects invalid credentials")
        login(page, ADMIN_USER, "wrong")
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        assert "invalid" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower()

        print("== admin login, monitor dashboard, map, audit")
        login(page, ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASS)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Administrator"
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Monitor").click()
        for cat in ["Samples", "Workers", "Collection nodes & laboratories", "Connections", "Routes", "Handoffs", "Delays", "Exceptions"]:
            page.get_by_role("tab", name=re.compile("^" + re.escape(cat))).click()
            page.get_by_role("tabpanel", name=cat).wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Live map", exact=True).click()
        page.locator("canvas").first.wait_for(timeout=20000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Audit").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        page.get_by_role("row").nth(1).wait_for()
        rows_before = page.get_by_role("row").count()
        page.get_by_label("Action").fill("auth.sign_in")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        assert page.get_by_role("row").count() > 1
        print("   audit rows", rows_before)
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()
        page.goto(BASE + "/monitor")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()

        print("== multi-role user: role switch control")
        login(page, f"lab_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("heading", name=re.compile("Select the role")).wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Laboratory intake operator").click()
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Laboratory intake operator"
        sel = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Active role")
        opts = sel.locator("option").all_inner_texts()
        assert "Requester" in opts and "Laboratory intake operator" in opts, opts
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Facility").click()
        page.get_by_text(re.compile("Regular capacity|Capacity")).first.wait_for()
        sel.select_option(label="Requester")
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        assert page.get_by_test_id("active-role").inner_text() == "Requester"
        opts2 = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Active role").locator("option").all_inner_texts()
        assert opts == opts2, (opts, opts2)

        print("== requester: form validation + serviceability dry run")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="New request").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile("Check serviceability")).click()
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        print("== requester with samples: work view + sample view")
        login(page, f"req_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile("My (work|requests)")).click()
        page.get_by_role("tab", name=re.compile("Past work")).click()
        page.get_by_role("tabpanel", name="Past work").wait_for()
        assert page.get_by_role("tabpanel", name="Past work").get_by_role("article").count() >= 1
        page.get_by_role("tab", name=re.compile("Current work")).click()
        page.get_by_role("tabpanel", name="Current work").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("tab", name=re.compile("Past work")).click()
        page.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile("^Sample ")).first.click()
        page.get_by_role("region", name="Status timeline").get_by_role("listitem").first.wait_for()
        print("   timeline entries", page.get_by_role("region", name="Status timeline").get_by_role("listitem").count())
        page.get_by_test_id("custodian").wait_for()
        page.get_by_test_id("freshness").wait_for()
        page.get_by_test_id("route-progress").wait_for()
        page.get_by_test_id("last-location").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        print("== courier: past work list")
        login(page, f"cour1_{TAG}", PW)
        page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Main").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("tab", name=re.compile("Past work")).click()
        page.get_by_role("tabpanel", name="Past work").get_by_role("article").first.wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()

        browser.close()
    bad = [u for u in external if not (u.startswith("http://127.0.0.1") or u.startswith("blob:http://127.0.0.1") or u.startswith("data:"))]
    assert not bad, f"external requests: {bad[:5]}"
    real_errors = [e for e in console_errors if "favicon" not in e]
    assert any("style.json" in u and st == 200 for u, st in map_assets), map_assets
    assert any("sprites/" in u and st == 200 for u, st in map_assets), map_assets
    assert any(".pmtiles" in u and st in (200, 206) for u, st in map_assets), map_assets
    assert not [m for m in map_assets if m[1] >= 400], [m for m in map_assets if m[1] >= 400]
    assert not [e for e in real_errors if "sprite" in e.lower()], real_errors
    print("console errors:", real_errors[:5])
    print("UI OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery System

Manages clinical sample logistics end-to-end: serviceability checks, collection requests,
certified collection and sealing, multi-leg transport with confirmed chain of custody,
node/laboratory handling, capacity reservations, fair assignment offers, disruption
replanning, a live map, and a searchable audit trail.

- **Backend:** Go (`backend/`, module `labsample`) — HTTP API under `/api`, WebSocket/long-poll
  events at `/api/events`, readiness at `/ready`, serves the built frontend and map assets.
- **Frontend:** React + TypeScript (Vite) in `frontend/`, MapLibre GL JS with the local PMTiles
  basemap served from `/map-assets/` (no external network access).
- **Datastore:** PostgreSQL only (`datastoresUsed: ["postgresql"]`). All durable state —
  users, sessions, network, journeys, assignments, custody, capacity, audit, events — lives there.

The HTTP API implements `contracts/openapi.contract.json` exactly; `app-setup/openapi.json`
is the published copy (identical paths/schemas, with descriptions).

## Prerequisites

- Go 1.25, Node.js / npm (both preinstalled in the container).
- PostgreSQL reachable at `DATABASE_URL`
  (default `postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable`).
- Map assets at `MAP_ASSETS_DIR` (default `/opt/arena/map-assets`).

## Build

```bash
bash app-setup/build.sh
```

Compiles `backend/bin/server`, installs frontend dependencies, type-checks and bundles the
frontend into `frontend/dist`.

## Reset

```bash
bash app-setup/reset.sh
```

Run while the application is stopped. Drops and recreates every table and index
(`backend/internal/db/schema.sql`) so the full structure is materialised immediately.
Running it repeatedly yields the same clean state. Leaves the application stopped.

## Run

```bash
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD='change-me' bash app-setup/start.sh
```

Runs in the foreground on `http://127.0.0.1:8080` (override with `PORT`). On first start with
no users, the administrator account is created from `ADMIN_USERNAME` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD`;
later restarts never duplicate or remove users.

| URL | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8080` | Web UI |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8080/api` | JSON API (bearer session token from `POST /api/authenticate-user`) |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8080/ready` | `{"status":"ready"}` once the database is reachable |

Environment variables: `PORT`, `DATABASE_URL`, `STATIC_DIR`, `MAP_ASSETS_DIR`,
`ADMIN_USERNAME`, `ADMIN_PASSWORD`.

## Test

```bash
# unit/compile checks
(cd backend && go build ./... && go vet ./...)
(cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json)

# end-to-end API scenario against a running app (prints "ALL OK")
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD='change-me' python3 scripts/e2e_smoke.py
```

`scripts/e2e_smoke.py` builds a network, onboards every role, runs the full lifecycle
(serviceability dry run → request → collection & seal → relay handoffs → hub checkpoint →
laboratory receipt), plus pre-sealed ingest, Frost/Pulse handling rules, disruption
replanning, audit search and the event stream. It prints the random `tag` it used.

Browser-level UI check (requires Playwright + Chromium, e.g. `pip install playwright &&
playwright install chromium`):

```bash
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD='change-me' python3 scripts/ui_smoke.py <tag-from-e2e>
```

It exercises the UI contract scenarios (login rejection, role switching, work views, sample
timeline/freshness, monitor dashboard, audit search, sign-out, request-form validation,
serviceability dry run) and asserts the map loads only local `/map-assets/` resources.

## Typical clean cycle

```bash
bash app-setup/build.sh
bash app-setup/reset.sh
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD='change-me' bash app-setup/start.sh
```

# Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery — repository notes

## Layout
- `backend/` Go module `labsample` (Go 1.25). `cmd/server` entrypoint (`--reset` flag materialises schema and exits).
  - `internal/core` domain services (auth, admin, requests, planning/network, assign, work, journeys, views, monitor).
  - `internal/httpapi` router (`server.go`), realtime events (`events.go`).
  - `internal/db/schema.sql` full PostgreSQL schema (only datastore used).
- `frontend/` React + TypeScript (Vite), MapLibre GL with local PMTiles served at `/map-assets/`.
- `app-setup/` manifest, openapi.json, build/start/reset scripts.
- `scripts/e2e_smoke.py` end-to-end API test (needs running app; `requests` available in /opt/arena/venv).
- `contracts/openapi.contract.json` is the pinned API contract — do not deviate.

## Environment
- Datastores: `sudo /opt/arena/bin/start-services.sh` starts PostgreSQL (postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena), MongoDB, Redis.
- Go deps vendored in /opt/arena/dependencies (GOFLAGS/GOPROXY preconfigured); frontend deps in /opt/arena/dependencies/frontend.
- Terminal tool: one command per call (chain with `&&`).

## Conventions
- All API responses wrap success in `{"data": ...}`; errors are `{"error","code"}`.
- Session tokens are opaque (table `sessions`); active role is per-session.
- Audit log is the sample timeline source (`audit_log.sample_ids`); `sample.status.<status>` actions are status changes.
- Planner: first mile home→entry node is a transport leg; node assignment at each intermediate node; laboratory assignment at the end.
- Replanning creates a replacement journey (`parent_journey_id`), preserving finished/in-progress assignments via `preserved_assignment_ids`.

## Testing
- `cd backend && go build ./... && go vet ./...`
- Start app, then `python3 scripts/e2e_smoke.py` (expects ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD env, default admin/admin123). Works on a used DB (retires old workers, random region). Prints `tag <hex>` for the users it created (`req_<tag>`, `cour1_<tag>`, `lab_<tag>`, … password `Passw0rd!`).
- UI: `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/tmp/pw-browsers /tmp/pwenv/bin/python scripts/ui_smoke.py <tag>` (playwright venv at /tmp/pwenv — /opt/arena/venv is read-only; recreate with `python3 -m venv /tmp/pwenv && /tmp/pwenv/bin/pip install playwright && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/tmp/pw-browsers /tmp/pwenv/bin/playwright install chromium` if missing).
- Playwright selectors rely on accessible roles/labels: nav link "Live map" (not "Map"), monitor `tab` names, audit action for logins is `auth.sign_in`.

## Map gotchas
- Supplied `style.json` uses root-relative `sprite`/`glyphs`/`pmtiles:///` URLs; MapLibre 5 rejects relative sprite URLs. `MapView.tsx` fetches the style, absolutizes URLs (`absolutizeStyle`) and applies it with `setStyle`; overlay sources/layers are added on the subsequent `style.load`.
- Only glyph range `0-255.pbf` ships with the assets; other glyph ranges 404 by design (harmless).
- Kill a running server with `pkill -f "backend/bin/server$"` before re-running start.sh (port 8080).

action.message:
The Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery application is complete and verified end-to-end.

## What was done in this session

**UI smoke test fixed and passing (`scripts/ui_smoke.py`)**
- Strict-mode violation: nav link is "Live map" (exact match), not "Map".
- Audit filter used a wrong action name — the backend logs logins as `auth.sign_in`.
- Allowed MapLibre's own local `blob:` worker URLs in the no-external-requests check.
- Added assertions that the map loads **only** local `/map-assets/` resources (style, PMTiles range requests, glyphs, sprites) and that no sprite errors appear in the console.

**Real map bug found and fixed (`frontend/src/components/MapView.tsx`)**
- The supplied `style.json` uses root-relative `sprite`/`glyphs`/`pmtiles:///` URLs, which MapLibre 5 rejects ("Invalid sprite URL … must be absolute"). The map now fetches the style, rewrites those URLs to the page origin (`absolutizeStyle`), applies it via `setStyle`, and adds overlay layers on the resulting `style.load`. Sprites, glyphs and tiles all load with HTTP 200/206 from the local server.

**Full clean-cycle verification (as the evaluator will run it)**
- Stopped the old server → `build.sh` → `reset.sh` ×2 (identical clean state) → `start.sh` → `/ready` returns `{"status":"ready"}` → initial admin created from `ADMIN_USERNAME`/`ADMIN_PASSWORD`.
- `scripts/e2e_smoke.py` → **ALL OK** (serviceability dry run, requests, collection/seal, relay handoffs & custody, node/hub checkpoints, lab receipt, pre-sealed ingest, Frost/Pulse rules, disruption replanning, audit, events).
- `scripts/ui_smoke.py` → **UI OK** in headless Chromium.
- Restart check: user count unchanged (22), exactly one `admin`; stopping `start.sh` leaves no server processes behind.
- `app-setup/openapi.json` paths and component schemas are identical to `contracts/openapi.contract.json`; `initialAdmin.loginOperationId` = `authenticate_user` is present.

**Documentation**
- Replaced the stub `README.md` with build / reset / run / test instructions, URLs, env vars and the typical clean cycle.
- Updated `AGENTS.md` with testing workflow, Playwright selector notes and the map-asset gotchas.

## Deliverables
- `app-setup/`: `manifest.json`, `openapi.json`, `build.sh`, `start.sh`, `reset.sh`
- `backend/` (Go, PostgreSQL only), `frontend/` (React + TS + MapLibre/PMTiles)
- `scripts/e2e_smoke.py` (API), `scripts/ui_smoke.py` (browser), `scripts/gen_openapi.py`

The server is currently stopped; start it with `ADMIN_USERNAME=… ADMIN_PASSWORD=… bash app-setup/start.sh` from `/workspace`.
